Effect.description: What happened to the measure as reported, before polarity is applied.
Effect.title: Effect

claim.description: One plain-language sentence stating the finding.
claim.title: Claim

quote.description: The sentence from the abstract that reports this finding, copied exactly.
quote.title: Quote

outcome_reported.description: The outcome measure as the abstract names it, such as 'PHQ-9 score'.
outcome_reported.title: Outcome Reported

effect.description: What happened to the measure with the intervention compared with the comparator: increased, decreased, or no_change when the abstract reports no significant difference.

is_primary.description: True if the abstract names this as the study's primary outcome.
is_primary.title: Is Primary

intervention.description: Agent, dose, duration, route and form, as reported.
intervention.title: Intervention

comparator.description: Placebo, active treatment or usual care, as reported.
comparator.title: Comparator

baseline_vitamin_d_status.description: Baseline serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D band of this finding's population, cut at 20 ng/mL (50 nmol/L), the deficiency cut-off in the Endocrine Society's 2011 guideline; its 2024 guideline endorses no thresholds, so the cut-off only groups studies. A subgroup finding takes its subgroup's band. Assign the band by precedence: (a) if the population was restricted by vitamin D status at eligibility, use that restriction; (b) otherwise, use the baseline mean or median the abstract reports for that population; (c) use mixed only when the abstract reports values on both sides of 20 ng/mL with no single summary for that population; (d) otherwise not_reported. below_20_ng_ml: below 20 ng/mL (50 nmol/L). at_or_above_20_ng_ml: 20 ng/mL (50 nmol/L) or higher.
baseline_vitamin_d_status.title: Baseline Vitamin D Status

sample_size.description: Participants enrolled or randomized, not analyzed; null if the abstract does not say.
sample_size.title: Sample Size

review_summary.description: For a systematic review or meta-analysis only: one sentence summarizing its conclusion. Null for any other design.
review_summary.title: Review Summary

findings.description: Every finding the abstract reports, one per outcome, arm or subgroup. Empty for a systematic review or meta-analysis.
findings.title: Findings
